request.title: Reset the build server's checkout to origin/main
request.why: It discards two local commits; the safety policy lets only the owner run irreversible git resets.
request.context: The build server is 2 commits ahead (old generated reports you said to drop) and 169 behind.
request.command: cd ~/code/mobile-apps && git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main && git log --oneline -1

ack.note: Verified: build server HEAD now matches origin/main.
